value.body: Compensation and benefits (C&B) analysts handle the numbers side of HR. They work on salary structures, annual increments and bonuses, and benefits such as group health insurance. They sit in HR teams of mid-size and large companies, or at HR consulting firms that run pay surveys.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA (HR or Finance), B.Com, or an MBA in HR

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, HRMS software, pay survey reports

items.label: Common starting titles
items.value: C&B analyst, total rewards associate, HR analyst

items.label: MBA enrolment (all modes)
items.note: All specialisations; AISHE does not separate MBA (HR)
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), Table 11, actual responses

items.label: BBA enrolment (all modes)
items.note: All specialisations, including HR and Finance
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), Table 11, actual responses

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Pure C&B roles often go to MBA (HR) graduates or to people with a year or two in HR operations or payroll. BBA graduates usually reach them through HR operations or payroll roles; strong Excel skills are the common requirement.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next steps: C&B manager, total rewards lead, or HR analytics.
Fewer entry openings than general HR roles; payroll experience is a common bridge.
